entities.summary: William Iain Henderson is an Irish rugby union player from Northern Ireland who plays as a lock for United Rugby Championship club Ulster and the Ireland national team. He has been selected for two tours with the British & Irish Lions. Henderson has been the captain of Ulster since 2019 and captained Ireland in 2021 and 2023.
